name: zig-analyzer
description: Zig Analyzer provides language server support for the Zig programming language.
author: Jassiel Ovando

zigAnalyzer.serverPath.description: Path to the zig-analyzer executable. If empty, the extension won't start the language server.

zigAnalyzer.zigPath.description: Path to the zig executable, used by "Zig Analyzer: Run Build Step" to list and run build.zig steps.

zigAnalyzer.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the zig-analyzer language server.

zigAnalyzer.formatter.command.markdownDescription:
The formatter executable to run for "Format Document". **Must behave like `zig fmt --stdin`**: read the entire document from stdin, write the fully formatted result to stdout, and exit with code 0 on success. A nonzero exit or any stderr output is treated as a formatting failure and the document is left unchanged.

Combined with `#zigAnalyzer.formatter.args#` to build the full command line. Change this if the zero-config standard formatter (`zig fmt`) isn't what you want — e.g. a different Zig toolchain, or a wrapper script that also runs a linter — as long as it honors the stdin/stdout contract above. Set `#zigAnalyzer.formatter.enable#` to `false` (or clear this to an empty string) to disable server formatting.

zigAnalyzer.formatter.args.description: Arguments passed to zigAnalyzer.formatter.command. The default runs the standard, zero-config `zig fmt --stdin`.

zigAnalyzer.formatter.enable.description: Whether zig-analyzer provides document formatting. When false, Format Document is left to other providers (or disabled).

zigAnalyzer.inlayHints.enable.description: Enable inlay hints from zig-analyzer (parameter names at call sites). Requires the editor's Inlay Hints setting to also be on.

zigAnalyzer.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show parameter-name inlay hints before call-site arguments.

zigAnalyzer.inlayHints.excludeSingleArgu.description: Omit parameter-name inlay hints for calls with exactly one argument.

zigAnalyzer.inlayHints.types.description: Show inferred-type inlay hints for const/var declarations initialized with a literal (e.g. a string) and no explicit type annotation.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Executable paths (zigAnalyzer.serverPath, zigAnalyzer.zigPath, zigAnalyzer.formatter.command) are ignored in untrusted workspaces to prevent a workspace from silently configuring code execution.
